what_to_detect: Two or more extort trigger records fired for one spell cast from one source holding as many instances of extort, one record per instance.
near_miss: One extort trigger record fired for the spell cast from a source holding a single instance.
record_fields: the acting line, the keyword's own sidecar line (api Keyword)
the source entity's instances of the keyword in the trigger record's snapshot (printed keyword lines, granted_attached, granted_temporary.keywords)
